Name: Abiezer
Summary: Abiezer, son of Gilead — called Jeezer in the census list — founded a clan of Manasseh whose families later settled west of the Jordan.
KeyStory: Abiezer's clan is named in the second census and again when the daughters of Zelophehad's kinsmen received their inheritance.
LifeLesson: Even a single mention means God did not overlook him.
